Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Danish National School of Performing Arts, the country's main public higher education institution for the performing arts, trains in dance, musical theatre and drama, with no puppetry stream. The Danish trainings identified in the field belong to another register: Thy Teater ran a two-year foundation course for puppet builders between 1996 and 2000, now defunct, and the Viborg college, Thisted branch, has run an animation course since 2004 which cooperates with Thy Teater without being a puppeteer training. Neither satisfies the denominator. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1. Estimate, resting on search summaries.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
